analyzed: sāmi ardha jugupsā arthakaḥ amā saha samīpa arthakaḥ evam iva itthā arthakaḥ prakāra upamā aṃgīkāra avadhāraṇa arthakaḥ ca nūnam tarka niścaya arthakaḥ kim pracchā jugupsana arthakaḥ nāma prākāśya saṃbhāvya krodha upagama kutsana arthakaḥ alam bhūṣaṇa paryāpti śakti vāraṇa vācaka arthakaḥ hum vitarka paripraśna arthakaḥ samayā antika madhyama arthakaḥ

original: punaḥ aprakhamabhinnatārthakaḥ| niḥ niścayaniṣedhārthakāḥ kila vārtāsaṃbhāvanārthakaḥ| niḥ niścayaniṣedhārthakaḥ| purā prabandhanikaṭāgāmikacirātītārthakaḥ| ūrī urī ūrarī vistārā'ṅgīkārārthakāḥ| kila vārtāsaṃbhāvanārthakaḥ| khalu niṣedhavākyā'laṃkārajijñāsā'nunayā'rthakaḥ| abhitaḥ samīpobhayaśīghrasākalyā'bhimukhārthakaḥ|
analyzed: punar niścaya niṣedha arthakāḥ kila vārtā saṃbhāvanā arthakaḥ niḥ niścaya niṣedha arthakaḥ purā prabandha nikaṭa āgāmika cira atīta arthakaḥ ūrī urī ūrarī vistāra aṅgīkāra arthakāḥ kila vārtā saṃbhāvanā arthakaḥ khalu niṣedha vākya alaṃkāra jijñāsā anunaya arthakaḥ abhitas samīpa ubhaya śīghra sākalya abhimukha arthakaḥ

original: prāduḥ nāmaprākāśyārthakaḥ| mithaḥ anyo'nyarahasyārthakaḥ| tiraḥ antardhitiryagarthakaḥ hā viṣādaśugartikutsārthakaḥ| ahaha ud‌bhutakhedārthakaḥ| hi hetvavadhāraṇārthakaḥ| ciraṃ cirāya-cirarātrāya-cirasyacireṇa-cirāt-cire-cirārthako dīrghakālārthakaḥ| muhuḥ punaḥ-punaḥ śaśvadabhīkṣṇamasakṛdarthakaḥ|
analyzed: prādur nāma prākāśya arthakaḥ mithas anyonya rahasya arthakaḥ tiras antardhi tiryak arthakaḥ hā viṣāda śuc arti kutsa arthakaḥ ahaha udbhuta kheda arthakaḥ hi hetu avadhāraṇa arthakaḥ ciram cirāya cira rātrāya cirasya cireṇa cirāt cirecira arthakaḥ dīrgha kāla arthakaḥ muhur punar punar śaśvat abhīkṣṇam asakṛt arthakaḥ

original: tatkṣaṇaṃ strāk-bhaktaṭityañjasāhāyadrāṅ‌maṃkṣusapadidrutārthakam| atiśayaḥ balavatsuṣṭhu-kimutasvastyatīvanirbharārthakaḥ| varjanam pṛthag‌vinā'ntareṇartehiruṅ‌nānārthakam| hetuḥ yatatattatoyata ityarthakaḥ| cit cana asakalāthau| jātu kadācidarthakaḥ| saha sārdhaṃ sākaṃ satrā samaṃ sahetyarthakaḥ| prādhvam-ānukūlyārthakaḥ|
analyzed: tad kṣaṇam atiśayaḥ balavat suṣṭhu kim uta svasti atīva nirbhara arthakaḥ varjanam pṛthak vinā antareṇa ṛte hi ruṅ nānā arthakam hetuḥ yata tat tataḥ yatas iti arthakaḥ cit cana a sakala athau jātu kadācid arthakaḥ saha sārdham sākam satrā samam saha iti arthakaḥ prādhvam ānukūlya arthakaḥ

original: mudhā vyarthakavyarthavṛthā'rthakaḥ| virtaka aho āho utā'ho kiṃ kimutetyādyarthakaḥ| tu hi ca sma ha vai pādapūraṇārthakāḥ| su suṣṭhucārupūjanabhṛśasmṛddhiprabhṛtyarthakaḥ| agram puraḥ purataḥ prānta ityarthakaḥ| amutra pretya bhavāntarārthakau| va vā yathā tathā evaivaṃ sāmyārthakāḥ| aho hī vismayārthakau| tūṣṇīṃ tūṣṇīkāṃ maunārthakau|
analyzed: mudhā vyarthaka vyartha vṛthārthakaḥ aho āho uta aho kim kim uta ityādi arthakaḥ tu hi ca sma ha vai pāda pūraṇa arthakāḥ su suṣṭhu cāru pūjana bhṛśa smṛddhi prabhṛti arthakaḥ agram puras puratas prānte iti arthakaḥ amutra pretya bhava antara arthakau vā yathā tathā eva evam sāmya arthakāḥ aho hī vismaya arthakau tūṣṇīm tūṣṇīkām mauna arthakau

original: divyā śam upajoṣaṃ kalyāṇārthakāḥ| antarā'ntareṇā'ntare madhyārthakāḥ| prasahya haṭhārthakaḥ| ucitaṃ sāmprataṃ sthāne yuktārthakāḥ| abhīkṣṇaṃ śaśvadanārataṃ nirantarārthakāḥ| a ana nahi no na svalpārthapratiṣedhā'bhāvā'rthakāḥ| mā sma mā'laṃ vāraṇārthakau| ced yadi pakṣāntarārthakaḥ| uddhā'ñjasā tattvārthakau| prāduḥ āviḥ prakaṭārthāḥ|
analyzed: śam upajoṣam kalyāṇa arthakāḥ antarā antareṇa antare madhya arthakāḥ prasahya haṭha arthakaḥ ucitam sāmpratam sthāne yukta arthakāḥ abhīkṣṇam śaśvat anāratam nirantara arthakāḥ nahi no na su alpa artha pratiṣedha abhāva arthakāḥ mā sma mā alam vāraṇa arthakau ced yadi pakṣa antara arthakaḥ tattva arthakau prādur āvis prakaṭa arthāḥ

original: om‌ evaṃ paramam anumatyarthakāḥ| paritaḥ sarvataḥ viśvak samantatārthakāḥ| astu abhyanujñārthakāḥ| nanu ca virodhārthakau| kaccikau| iṣṭapraśanārthakaḥ| niḥṣamaṃ duḥṣamaṃ garhyārthakau| yathāsvaṃ yathāyatham yogyaprakārārthakau| mṛṣā mithyā vitathārthakau| yārthakaḥ| evaṃ tu punaḥ vai eva hi avadhāraṇārthakāḥ nūnam| avaśyaṃ niścayārthakau|
analyzed: om evam paramam anumati arthakāḥ paritas sarvatas viśvak samantataḥ arthakāḥ astu abhyanujñā arthakāḥ nanu ca virodha arthakau kaccikau iṣṭa praśanā arthakaḥ niḥṣamam duḥṣamam garhya arthakau yathāsvam yathāyatham yogya prakāra arthakau mṛṣā mithyā vitatha arthakau evam tu punar vai eva hi avadhāraṇa arthakāḥ nūnam avaśyam niścaya arthakau

original: arvāk avarārthakāḥ| ām evaṃ niścayārthakau| svayam ātmanā nijārthakau| nīcaiḥ alpārthakaḥ| uccaiḥ mahatārthakaḥ| prāyo bahulaṃ bahuguṇārthakau| śanaiḥ adratārthakaḥ| sanāt sanat nityārthakau| sma atītārthakaḥ| astam adarśanārthakam| u ruṣoktikopanārthakaḥ| ūṃpraśnārthakaḥ| ayi anunayasāntvanārthakaḥ| huṃ tarkārthakaḥ duṣṭhu nindārthakaḥ|
analyzed: arvāk avara arthakāḥ ām evam niścaya arthakau svayam ātmanā nija arthakau nīcais alpa arthakaḥ uccais mahatā arthakaḥ prāyas bahulam bahu guṇa arthakau śanais adrata arthakaḥ sanāt sanat nitya arthakau sma atīta arthakaḥ astam adarśana arthakam ruṣā ukti kopana arthakaḥ ūṃpraśna arthakaḥ ayi anunaya sāntvana arthakaḥ hum tarka arthakaḥ duṣṭhu nindā arthakaḥ

original: suṣṭhu praśaṃsanārthakaḥ| prage prātararthakaḥ| nikaṣā antikārthakaḥ| parut pūrvavarṣārthakaḥ| parāri eṣamasṛ pūrvataravarṣārthakau| paredyavi uttaradivasārthakāḥ| hyaḥ atītadinārthakaḥ| paraśvaḥ parataradīnārthakaḥ| etarhi sampratīdānīmadhunā sāmpratam etatkālārthakāḥ| caṭacaṭādiḥ humphaṭ hu vāidistomaḥ|
analyzed: suṣṭhu praśaṃsana arthakaḥ prage prātar arthakaḥ nikaṣā antika arthakaḥ parudh pūrva varṣa arthakaḥ parāri pūrvatara varṣa arthakau paredyavi uttara divasa arthakāḥ hyas atīta dina arthakaḥ paraśvas paratara dīna arthakaḥ etarhi samprati idānīm adhunā sāmpratam etad kāla arthakāḥ caṭacaṭā ādiḥ hum phaṭ hu vāidistomaḥ

original: huṃ kodhabījam, phaṭ astrabījaṃ, hāvu hāvu bāvu stomāḥ mantraikadeśāḥ, te ādhunikasaṃketavantaḥ| cādayo nipātāḥ svārthe samuccayādau ca| prādayaḥ prakarṣādyarthe| temanaṃ vyañjanārthakam| gauḥ rūḍham| gaṃgā tīralakṣakam| paṃkajaṃ yogarūḍham| pācakaṃ yaugikam| maṇḍapaḥ yaugikarūḍhā| mahārajataṃ suvarṇavācakam| ahaṃ kartṛśaktikatam|
analyzed: hum kodha bījam phaṭ astra bījam hāvu hāvu bāvu stomāḥ mantra ekadeśāḥ te ādhunika saṃketavantaḥ ca ādayaḥ nipātāḥ svārthe samuccaya ādau ca pra ādayaḥ prakarṣa ādi arthe temanam vyañjana arthakam gauḥ rūḍham gaṃgā tīra lakṣakam paṃkajam yoga rūḍham pācakam yaugikam maṇḍapaḥ yaugika rūḍhā mahārajatam suvarṇa vācakam aham

original: ruḍhasaṃjñā naimittikī pāribhāṣikī aupādhikī ca| tatra jātyavacchinnasaṃketavatī naimittikī gocaitrādiḥ| paribhāṣayā śabdāśraya ākāśaḥ, pucchādimān paśuḥ, paribhāṣayā kāṣṭhagajo hitthaḥ| dhanavān śreṣṭhī| upādhinā kriyayā vā cāñcalyena capalaścaṃcalādiḥ, pṛthivyādini bhūtāni, jaḍaḥ ceṣṭārahitaprāṇī| mūrkhaḥ vidyādirahitaprāṇī|
analyzed: ruḍha saṃjñā naimittikī pāribhāṣikī aupādhikī ca tatra jāti avacchinna saṃketavatī naimittikī go caitra ādiḥ paribhāṣayā śabda āśrayaḥ ākāśaḥ puccha ādimān paśuḥ paribhāṣayā kāṣṭha gajaḥ hitthaḥ dhanavān śreṣṭhī upādhinā kriyayā vā cāñcalyena capalaḥ caṃcala ādiḥ pṛthivī ādini bhūtāni jaḍaḥ ceṣṭā rahita prāṇī mūrkhaḥ vidyā ādi rahita prāṇī

original: mūkaḥ vāṇīrahitaprāṇī| ādhunikasaṃkateḥ paribhāṣā pakṣatādiḥ, prakṛtistredhā nāma ghaṭādyāḥ| dhātavaḥ bhū as kṛñ‌ prabhṛtayaḥ kriyāśaktāḥ| prātipadikā rāmādyāḥ| lākṣaṇikā dākṣipācakādyā api| jātyakhaṇḍopādhīnāṃ svarūpato bhānam| pramā pramāṇaṃ paribhāṣyā'rthabodhake bhavataḥ| arthavādāḥ śābdabodhajanakā iti mīmāṃsakāḥ| taratamāḥ prakarṣārthakāḥ|
analyzed: mūkaḥ vāṇī rahita prāṇī ādhunika saṃkateḥ paribhāṣā pakṣatā ādiḥ prakṛtiḥ tredhā nāma ghaṭa ādyāḥ dhātavaḥ bhū as kṛñ prabhṛtayaḥ kriyā śaktāḥ prātipadikāḥ rāma ādyāḥ lākṣaṇikāḥ dākṣi pācaka ādyāḥ api jāti akhaṇḍa upādhīnām svarūpataḥ bhānam pramā pramāṇam paribhāṣya artha bodhake bhavataḥ artha vādāḥ śābda bodha janakāḥ iti mīmāṃsakāḥ taratamāḥ prakarṣa arthakāḥ

original: matup praśaṃsādyarthakaḥ| bhavatītyatra śābdabodhajanakatāvacchedakaḥ śaṃp ākāṃkṣāsampādakaḥ| praparādyāstu lakṣaṇāyāṃ nirūḍhatvasampādakā apīti kecit| sup‌tiṅ‌kṛttaddhitāḥ sarve'pi svattayaḥ svādyā yogabalātsaṃkhyādiparāḥ| san-talādyāḥ svarūpamātrārthā api bhavanti| bhāvavihitaghañādyā api svarūpamātrārthā bhavanti|
analyzed: matup praśaṃsā ādi arthakaḥ bhavati iti atra śābda bodha janakatā avacchedakaḥ śaṃp ākāṃkṣā sampādakaḥ praparā ādyāḥ tu lakṣaṇāyām nirūḍha tva sampādakāḥ api iti kecid sup tiṅ kṛt taddhitāḥ sarve pi svattayaḥ sva ādyāḥ yoga balāt saṃkhyā ādi parāḥ santala ādyāḥ sva rūpa mātra arthāḥ api bhavanti bhāva vihita ghañ ādyāḥ api svarūpa mātra arthāḥ bhavanti

original: kriyāviśeṣaṇānām ekatvaṃ karmatvaṃ napuṃsakatvaṃ cā'nuśāsanāt svīkriyate| stokaḥ pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇe prathamāntaḥ, dhātvarthaviśeṣaṇe tu ekatvakarmatvanapuṃsakatvārthakaḥ| sthīyate ākhyātena, gataṃ ktena, draṣṭavyaṃ tavyena, kamaśo vartamānā'tītabhaviṣyakālapratyāyanam| pānaṃ dravadravyasya galā'dhaḥsaṃyogānukūlavyāpāraḥ|
analyzed: kriyā viśeṣaṇānām eka tvam karma tvam napuṃsaka tvam ca anuśāsanāt svīkriyate stokaḥ pratyaya artha viśeṣaṇe prathamā antaḥ dhātvartha viśeṣaṇe tu eka tva karma tva napuṃsaka tva arthakaḥ sthīyate ākhyātena gatam ktena draṣṭavyam tavyena kamaśas vartamāna atīta bhaviṣya kāla pratyāyanam pānam drava dravyasya gala adhas saṃyoga anukūla vyāpāraḥ

original: āvāpaḥ anvayitvam, udvāpaḥ vyatiriktatvam, prāptiparihārau kti| vivaraṇaṃ tulyārthakatā| kakudaḥ alaṃkṛtasasatkārakanyādātā| svārājyam inadratvam| svaḥ nityasukhasvargaḥ lakṣakapadam| arthasambandhavati vṛttirlakṣaṇā tadvallakṣakaṃ-samūho yātīti samūhitajano yātīti| saundhavapadaṃ lavaṇe turage'pi śaktam| gāc māc ādayaḥ ādhunikasaṃketitāḥ|
analyzed: āvāpaḥ anvayi tvam udvāpaḥ vyatirikta tvam prāpti parihārau kti vivaraṇam tulya arthaka tā kakudaḥ svārājyam inadra tvam svaḥ nitya sukha svargaḥ lakṣaka padam artha sambandhavati vṛttiḥ lakṣaṇā tadvat lakṣakam samūhaḥ yāti iti samūhita janaḥ yāti iti saundhava padam lavaṇe turaga api śaktam gāc māc ādayaḥ ādhunika saṃketitāḥ

original: mīmāṃsakā vākyamapi lakṣakaṃ manyante, citragosvāmīti| gaurvāhīkaḥ-gosadṛśe lakṣaṇā| bhāve ktaḥ| ālaṃkārikā vākye lakṣaṇāṃ svīkurvanti| kasadhātorvikasitārthe lakṣaṇā| dhenuḥ dhānakarmatvaśiṣṭagauḥ śaktyā rūḍhiḥ| ekākṣareṣu śaktiḥ naḥ kha, samudāye nakhaḥ| yogarūḍhaṃ tailam| tailaṃ yogena tilaprabhavaṃ rūḍhayā sneham|
analyzed: mīmāṃsakāḥ vākyam api lakṣakam manyante citra go svāmī iti gauḥ vāhīkaḥ go sadṛśe lakṣaṇā bhāve ktaḥ ālaṃkārikāḥ vākye lakṣaṇām svīkurvanti kasa dhātoḥ vikasita arthe lakṣaṇā dhenuḥ dhāna karma tva śiṣṭa gauḥ śaktyā rūḍhiḥ ekākṣareṣu śaktiḥ naḥ kha samudāye nakhaḥ yoga rūḍham tailam tailam yogena tila prabhavam rūḍhayā sneham

original: yogarūḍhyā tailaṃ patraṃ ceti| yogena paṃkajaṃ kumudaṃ rūḍhya pad‌mam| yogarūḍhe samāsaḥ kṛṣṇasarpādiḥ lohitaśalyamiti| kṛdantasya paṃkajādiyogarūḍhasya sāmāsikatvamapi| ikaṇ svārthe| pad‌manābho yudhiṣṭhiraḥ manasādevī yagarūḍhāḥ| yaugikaṃ tredhā-samāsaḥ, tadvitāktaṃ, kṛdantaṃ ca| dvandvo'pi yaugikaḥ| brāhmaṇī śvaśrūḥ śūdrā yaugikāni ṅīb‌ āṅ āpa|
analyzed: yoga rūḍhyā tailam patram ca iti yogena paṃkajam kumudam rūḍhya padmam yoga rūḍhe samāsaḥ kṛṣṇa sarpa ādiḥ lohita śalyam iti kṛt antasya paṃkaja ādi yoga rūḍhasya sāmāsika tvam api svārthe padmanābhaḥ yudhiṣṭhiraḥ manasādevī yaga rūḍhāḥ yaugikam tredhā samāsaḥ tad vita aktam kṛt antam ca dvandvaḥ api yaugikaḥ brāhmaṇī śvaśrūḥ śūdrā yaugikāni ṅīp āṅ āpa atha vā api atha vā api atha vā api atha vā api atha vā api atha vā

original: strītvaviśiṣṭabrāhmaṇavācakaṃ brāhmaṇīti| samāsānāṃ samudāyaśaktatvaṃ, samudāyatvam apekṣābuddhiviśeṣaviṣayatvam| padaṃ vibhaktyantaṃ, vā suptiṅantaṃ vā śaktaṃ padam| suptiṅantacayo vākyam, samarthaḥ padasamūho vākyam, vyañjakamapi padam, vyañjanayā vṛttyā ca lakṣaṇā, lakṣaṇāyā mūlaṃ vyañjanā śaktiḥ|
analyzed: strī tva viśiṣṭa brāhmaṇa vācakam brāhmaṇī iti samāsānām samudāya śakta tvam samudāya tvam apekṣā buddhi viśeṣa viṣaya tvam padam vibhakti antam vā sup tiṅ antam vā śaktam padam sup tiṅ anta cayaḥ vākyam samarthaḥ pada samūhaḥ vākyam vyañjakam api padam vyañjanayā vṛttyā ca lakṣaṇā lakṣaṇāyāḥ mūlam vyañjanā śaktiḥ

original: abhidhā śabdaśaktiḥ sā'pi mūlaṃ vyañjanāyā iti ca mūlaṃ sahakāri| śaktyā vṛttirjahatsvārthā gaṃgāyāstīre| śakyalakṣyobhayavṛttiśca ajahatsvārthā ghaṭapadasya dravye nīlaghaṭasya cāpi dravye| anāditātparyavatī nirūḍhā lakṣaṇā, aruṇaṃ raktam, aruṇayā gavā somaṃ krīṇātītyatra| āditātparyavatī ādhunikī ghaṭatvena ghaṭapadasya|
analyzed: abhidhā śabda śaktiḥ sā api mūlam vyañjanāyāḥ iti ca mūlam sahakāri śaktyā vṛttiḥ jahat svārthā gaṃgāyāḥ tīre śakya lakṣya ubhaya vṛttiḥ ca a jahat svārthā ghaṭa padasya dravye nīla ghaṭasya ca api dravye anādi tātparyavatī nirūḍhā lakṣaṇā aruṇam raktam aruṇayā gavā somam krīṇāti iti atra ādi tātparyavatī ādhunikī ghaṭa tvena ghaṭa padasya

original: gauṇī śakyadṛśī agnirmāṇavakaḥ agnisadṛśo māṇavakaḥ| śaktatvena lakṣakatvena ca padajñānaṃ hetuḥ| abhidhayā smṛtisahakāreṇa manasā bodhaḥ, lakṣaṇayā'pi smṛtisahakāreṇa manasā bodhaḥ, lakṣaṇayā'pi smṛtisahakāreṇa manasā bodhaḥ| vyañjanayā'pi tathā vyaṅgyārthasya bodhaḥ| smṛtisahakāreṇa vācyārthasya manasā bodhaḥ|
analyzed: gauṇī śakya dṛśī agniḥ māṇavakaḥ agni sadṛśaḥ māṇavakaḥ śakta tvena lakṣaka tvena ca pada jñānam hetuḥ abhidhayā smṛti sahakāreṇa manasā bodhaḥ lakṣaṇayā api smṛti sahakāreṇa manasā bodhaḥ lakṣaṇayā api smṛti sahakāreṇa manasā bodhaḥ vyañjanayā api tathā vyaṅgya arthasya bodhaḥ smṛti sahakāreṇa vācya arthasya manasā bodhaḥ

original: smṛtisahakāreṇa lakṣyārthasyāpi abhidhāyā lakṣaṇāyā vyañjanāyāśca vṛttitvena. pārthakyam| padārthopasthitiniyāmakaḥ saṃketo vṛttiḥ, tātparyajñānaṃ sākṣācchābdabodhopayogīti tātparyaṃ na vṛttirūpam| lakṣaṇāyāstu vṛttitvamāvaśyakam| padārthayorvācyavācakabhāvaḥ svatantraḥ sambandhaḥ|
analyzed: smṛti sahakāreṇa lakṣya arthasya api abhidhāyāḥ lakṣaṇāyāḥ vyañjanāyāḥ ca vṛtti tvena pārthakyam padārtha upasthiti niyāmakaḥ saṃketaḥ vṛttiḥ tātparya jñānam sākṣāt śābda bodha upayogi iti tātparyam na vṛtti rūpam lakṣaṇāyāḥ tu vṛtti tvam āvaśyakam padārthayoḥ vācya vācaka bhāvaḥ svatantraḥ sambandhaḥ

original: arthajñānaniṣṭhaśaktyā arthavācakatvaṃ padānāmiti tu mīmāṃsakāḥ padanityatvavādinaḥ|| kumārīlabhaṭṭastu padārthasaṃsargasyāpi vācyatvaṃ svīkaroti| śaktijñānaṃ padārthavācakatvāvagāhi, arthe padavācyatvā'vagāhi, cetyubhayavidhaṃ śābdabodhaprayojakam| ākāṃkṣā saṃsargabhānaniyāmikā| padārthadvayasaṃsarga ākāṃkṣābalalabhyaḥ|
analyzed: artha jñāna niṣṭha śaktyā artha vācaka tvam padānām iti tu mīmāṃsakāḥ pada nitya tva vādinaḥ kumārīlabhaṭṭaḥ tu padārtha saṃsargasya api vācyatvam svīkaroti śakti jñānam padārtha vācaka tva avagāhi arthe pada vācya tva avagāhi ca iti ubhayavidham śābdabodha prayojakam ākāṃkṣā saṃsarga bhāna niyāmikā padārtha dvaya saṃsargaḥ ākāṃkṣā bala labhyaḥ

original: vācyatve sati vācyavṛttitve sati vācyopasthitiprakāratvaṃ pravṛttinimitatvam sati vācyopasthitiprakāratvaṃ pravṛtinimittatvam| padārthaḥ padārthenā'nveti na tu padārthekadeśeneti tatra padārthatvaṃ bodhaviṣayatāśrayatvena saṃketaviṣayatvaṃ tadekadeśatvaṃ tu bodhaviṣayatā'vacchedakatvena saṃketaviṣayatvaṃ, tadeva śakyatāvacchedakamiti|
analyzed: vācya tve sati vācya vṛtti tve sati vācya upasthiti prakāra tvam pravṛtti nimita tvam sati vācya upasthiti prakāra tvam pravṛti nimitta tvam padārthaḥ padārthena anveti na tu padārtha eka deśena iti tatra padārtha tvam bodha viṣayatā āśraya tvena saṃketa viṣayatvam tad eka deśa tvam tu bodha viṣayatā avacchedaka tvena saṃketa viṣayatvam tat eva śakya tā avacchedakam iti

original: ākāśapadasya niravacchinne śaktiḥ| aṣṭadravyātiriktadravyatvena ākāśapadāvacyatvena vā ākāśapade lakṣaṇāyā upagamaḥ| yadvā ākāśaḥ śabdāśraya iti mukhyaktibodhaḥ| dravyaṃ nāsti gaurnāstītyatra tadā lakṣaṇā| svargadhenvādi lākṣikam| prābhākarāstu dhenupadasya dhānakarmatāviśiṣṭe śaktiḥ, na tu gotvaviśiṣṭe|
analyzed: ākāśa padasya niravacchinne śaktiḥ aṣṭa dravya atirikta dravya tvena ākāśa pada avacya tvena vā ākāśa pade lakṣaṇāyāḥ upagamaḥ yat vā ākāśaḥ śabda āśrayaḥ iti mukhya kti bodhaḥ dravyam na asti gauḥ na asti iti atra tadā lakṣaṇā svarga dhenu ādi lākṣikam prābhākarāḥ tu dhenu padasya dhāna karmatā viśiṣṭe śaktiḥ na tu go tva viśiṣṭe

original: divākaraniśākarayoḥ śaktaṃ puṣpavantapadamiti śaktigrahe ubhayaniṣṭhaviṣayatāyā aikyāt samūhālambanalilakṣaṇe ubhayatvadharmitāvacchedakatāpannacandratvasūryatvayoḥ śakyatāvacchedakatvaparyāptibhānimiti| puṣpavantapadāccandratvāvacchinnaviṣayatasūryatvāvacchinnaviṣayakaśābdabodho bhavatviti'tatra saṃketaḥ|
analyzed: divākara niśākarayoḥ śaktam puṣpavanta padam iti śaktigrahe ubhaya niṣṭha viṣayatāyāḥ aikyāt samūha ālambana li lakṣaṇe ubhaya tva dharmitā avacchedaka tā āpanna candra tva sūrya tvayoḥ śakyatā avacchedaka tva paryāpti bhā nimiti puṣpavanta padāt candra tva avacchinna viṣayata sūrya tva avacchinna viṣayaka śābda bodhaḥ bhavatu iti tatra saṃketaḥ

original: ubhayaviṣayakatvāvacchinnāyā bodhaniṣṭhasaṃketaviṣayatāyā aikyācchakteraikyam, na nānārthatā| ekayā uktyā śaktyā divākaraniśākarāvityamarakośo'pi|| sarvanāmapadānāmapi śakteraikyānna nānarthatā| haryādipadānāṃ nānārtheṣu śaktiḥ| yuṣmadasmadoḥ yuṣmatpadaviśiṣṭo bodho bhavatviti bhagavadicchāsaṃketaḥ|
analyzed: ubhaya viṣayaka tva avacchinnāyāḥ bodha niṣṭha saṃketa viṣayatāyāḥ aikyāt śakteḥ aikyam na nānārthatā ekayā uktyā śaktyā divākara niśākarau iti amarakośaḥ api sarvanāma padānām api śakteḥ aikyāt na nānarthatā hari ādi padānām nānā artheṣu śaktiḥ yuṣmad asmadoḥ yuṣmad pada viśiṣṭaḥ bodhaḥ bhavatu iti bhagavat icchā saṃketaḥ

original: prathame vaiśiṣṭyaṃ svaghaṭitavākyajanyabodhā''śrayatvaprakārakecchoddeśyatvā'vacchedakatvopalakṣitadhamāṃvacchinnaviṣayakatva-svajanyatvobhayasaṃsargeṇa| dvitāye vaiśiṣṭyaṃsvoccārayitṛtvā'vacchedakatvopalakṣitadharmāvakchinnaviṣayakatvasvajanyatvobhayasaṃsargaiṇeti|
analyzed: prathame vaiśiṣṭyam sva ghaṭita vākya janya bodha āśraya tva prakāraka icchā uddeśya tva avacchedaka tva upalakṣita dhama avacchinna viṣayaka tva sva janya tva ubhaya saṃsargeṇa dvitāye vaiśiṣṭyam sva uccārayitṛ tva avacchedaka tva upalakṣita dharma avakchinna viṣayaka tva sva janya tva ubhaya saṃsargaiṇa iti

original: svatvasya saṃsargakukṣipraviṣṭatayā nā'nanugamaḥ||'ayamahaṃ paṇḍita iti jānātītyuvāca' iti sthale sarvatra vākyārtho na karma, tatretipadaṃ tadvākyajanyajñānasamānākāraparam, itipadārthaḥ abhedena dhātvarthe tadavacchedakajñāne ca viśeṣaṇamiti sarvatra itipadaṃ yuṣmatpadaghaṭitā'vāntaravākyasthale tadvākyajanyajñānasamānākārakaparam||
analyzed: sva tvasya saṃsarga kukṣi praviṣṭa tayā na ananugamaḥ ayam aham paṇḍitaḥ iti jānāti iti uvāca iti sthale sarvatra vākya arthaḥ na karma tatra iti padam tad vākya janya jñāna samāna ākāra param iti pada arthaḥ abhedena dhātvarthe tad avacchedaka jñāne ca viśeṣaṇam iti sarvatra iti padam yuṣmat pada ghaṭita avāntara vākya sthale tad vākya janya jñāna samāna ākāraka param

original: tvaṃ sthūlaḥ ahaṃ sthūlaḥ, tvaṃ svargaṃ bhokṣyase ahaṃ svargaṃ bhokṣye ityubhayatraiva yuṣmadasmadormukhyatvāt sambodhyoccārayitṛśarīratadātmanoreva yuṣmadasmadarthathā| sarve ghaṭā rūpavanta ityatrā'śeṣatvaṃ sarvapadārthaḥ|
analyzed: tvam sthūlaḥ aham sthūlaḥ tvam svargam bhokṣyase aham svargam bhokṣye iti ubhayatra eva yuṣmad asmadoḥ mukhya tvāt sambodhya uccārayitṛ śarīra tad ātmanoḥ eva sarve ghaṭāḥ rūpavantaḥ iti atra aśeṣa tvam sarva padārthaḥ

original: uddeśyatāvacchedakavyāpakavidheyavyāpyaparyāptiko dharmaḥ sarvapadapravṛttinimittaṃ, tathāvidhadharmo'tra ghaṭādiniṣṭhayāvattvam vyāsajjyavṛttighaṭatvavyāpako rūpādivyāpyaśca, vyāpyavyāpatabhāvo'rthāllabhyate, uddeśyatāvacchejakavyāpakatvaṃ tu tatsamānādhikaraṇānyonyābhāvapratiyogitānavacchedakatvaṃ, yāvattvaparyāptiśca na bhinnā,
analyzed: uddeśya tā avacchedaka vyāpaka vidheya vyāpya paryāptikaḥ dharmaḥ sarva pada pravṛtti nimittam tathāvidha dharmaḥ utra ghaṭa ādi niṣṭha yāvat tvam vyāsajjya vṛtti ghaṭa tva vyāpakaḥ rūpa ādi vyāpyaḥ ca vyāpya vyāpata bhāvaḥ ūrthāt labhyate uddeśya tā avacchejaka vyāpaka tvam tu tad samāna adhikaraṇa anyonya abhāva pratiyogitā anavacchedaka tvam yāvat tva paryāptiḥ ca na bhinnā

original: vidheyavyāpyatvaṃ tu vyabhicāritvasambandhāvacchinnapratiyogitākatattadvidheyatāvacchedakāvacchinnapratiyogitākatattadvidheyā'bhāvavattvam|| kāle sarve vṛttimanta iti vidheyavācakapadasamānādhikaraṇasarvapadasya vidheyatāvacchedakavyāpakoddeśyatāvacchedakāvacchinnasambandhavyāpyaparyāptikaṃ yāvattvamarthaḥ|
analyzed: vidheya vyāpya tvam tu vyabhicāri tva sambandha avacchinna pratiyogitāka tad tad vidheyatā avacchedaka avacchinna pratiyogitāka tad tad vidheya abhāvavat tvam kāle sarve vṛttimantaḥ iti vidheya vācaka pada samāna adhikaraṇa sarva padasya vidheya tā avacchedaka vyāpaka uddeśya tā avacchedaka avacchinna sambandha vyāpya paryāptikam yāvat tvam arthaḥ

original: kālaḥ sarvadharmavān ityatrāpi sarvapadena vṛttimattvādivyāpakakālādisambandhavyāpyaparyāptikaṃ yāvattvaṃ pratītiviṣayam| sarvaṃ prameyamityatra anyonyābhāvapratiyogitānavacchedakavidheyavyāpyaparyāptikayāvattvārthatvaṃ sarvapadasya|
analyzed: kālaḥ sarva dharmavān iti atra api sarva padena vṛttimat tva ādi vyāpaka kāla ādi sambandha vyāpya paryāptikam yāvat tvam pratīti viṣayam sarvam prameyam iti atra anyonya abhāva pratiyogitā anavacchedaka vidheya vyāpya paryāptika yāvat tva artha tvam sarva padasya

original: ayaṃ sarvaṃ ghaṭaṃ vettītyatra idamīyajñāne nirūpakatayā dtīyārthaviṣayatāyā anvayasyā''nubhavikatvena idamīyajñānaviṣayatāvyāpyaghaṭatvavyāpakaparyāptipratiyogiyāvattvāvacchinne sarvapadaśaktiriti|
analyzed: ayam sarvam ghaṭam vetti iti atra idamīya jñāne nirūpaka tayā dtīya artha viṣayatāyāḥ anvayasya ānubhavika tvena idamīya jñāna viṣayatā vyāpya ghaṭa tva vyāpaka paryāpti pratiyogi yāvat tva avacchinne sarva pada śaktiḥ iti

original: atra na sarvāṇi rūpāṇītyatra nañarthapratiyogiviśeṣaṇārthakasarvaśabdasya svārthānvayitāvacchedakarūpatvādivyāpakaparyāptinirūpakayāvattvārthakatvena tadavicchannābhāvo ghaṭādāvabādhita eva sarvaṃ dravyaṃ na rūpavaditi dravyatvādivyāpakayāvattvasāmānādhikaraṇyabhāvasya pratīyate, anuyogiviśeṣaṇāvacchedenaiva nañā abhāvaḥ pratyāyyate|
analyzed: atra na sarvāṇi rūpāṇi iti atra nañ artha pratiyogi viśeṣaṇa arthaka sarva śabdasya sva artha anvayi tā avacchedaka rūpa tva ādi vyāpaka paryāpti nirūpaka yāvat tva arthaka tvena tad avicchanna abhāvaḥ ghaṭa ādau abādhitaḥ eva sarvam dravyam na rūpavat iti dravya tva ādi vyāpaka yāvat tva sāmānādhikaraṇya bhāvasya pratīyate anuyogi viśeṣaṇa avacchedena eva nañā abhāvaḥ pratyāyyate

original: caitro dadhi, maitraḥ payaḥ, jaitro ghṛtaṃ, paitrastu sarvaṃ bhuktaṃe' ityatra sarvapadaṃ tathāvidhayāvaddharmaprakārakaṃ badhaṃ janayatvitisaṃketarūpā vilakṣaṇā śaktiḥ 'ekasmai vā anyā iṣṭayaḥ kāmāyā''hriyante sarvebhyo darśapūrṇamāsau' ityatra tu pratyekaphalakāmasya tatrā'dhikārāt yogasiddhiḥ-pratyekaprayogasambandhenayogena tatatphalotpattiḥ
analyzed: caitraḥ dadhi maitraḥ payaḥ jaitraḥ ghṛtam paitraḥ tu sarvam iti atra sarva padam tathāvidha yāvat dharma prakārakam janayatu iti saṃketa rūpā vilakṣaṇā śaktiḥ ekasmai vā anyāḥ iṣṭayaḥ kāmāya āhriyante sarvebhyaḥ darśa pūrṇamāsau iti atra tu pratyeka phala kāmasya tatra adhikārāt yoga siddhiḥ pratyeka prayoga sambandhena yogena tad tad phala utpattiḥ

original: kameṇeti sarvebhya ityasya pratyekaprayogeṇa pratyekasmai iti pakṣo dṛḍhīkṛtaḥ| kiṃpadasya jijñāsite śaktiḥ, vaktṛjijñāsito dharmaḥ pravṛttinimittam| kasya putraḥ sundara ityatra tu viśeṣadharmāvacchinnaviśeṣitatadavacchinnaniṣṭhoddeśyatā'vacchedakatākaprakṛtavidheyajñānagocarecchā pratīyate|
analyzed: kameṇa iti sarvebhyaḥ iti asya pratyeka prayogeṇa pratyekasmai iti pakṣaḥ dṛḍhīkṛtaḥ kiṃpadasya jijñāsite śaktiḥ vaktṛ jijñāsitaḥ dharmaḥ pravṛtti nimittam kasya putraḥ sundaraḥ iti atra tu viśeṣa dharma avacchinna viśeṣita tad avacchinna niṣṭha uddeśya tā avacchedaka tāka prakṛta vidheya jñāna gocara icchā pratīyate

original: jijñāsite viśeṣadharmāvacchinne śaktiḥ ayaṃ kaḥ ityatra idantvāvacchinnāṃ'śe vidheyatāvacchedakatvena jijñāsitadharmavāniti bodhaḥ|
analyzed: jijñāsite viśeṣa dharma avacchinne śaktiḥ ayam kaḥ iti atra idantva avacchinna aṃśe vidheyatā avacchedaka tvena jijñāsita dharmavān iti bodhaḥ

original: idaṃ kiṃ dravyam, idaṃ kasya dhanam, bhavataḥ putrāḥ kṛti, bhavān kasya putraḥ, ityatra idantvāvacchinnoddeśyatānirūpitasvārthā'bhedā'nvayitā'vacchedakā'vacchinnavidheyatānirūpitā'bhedasambandhāvacchinnā'vacchedakatā'vacchedakatvena jijñāsito yo dravyatvasya viśeṣadharmastadvadabhinnadravyā'bhinnamidamiti bodhaḥ|
analyzed: idam kim dravyam idam kasya dhanam bhavataḥ putrāḥ bhavān kasya putraḥ iti atra idantva avacchinna uddeśyatā nirūpita svārtha abheda anvayitā avacchedaka avacchinna vidheyatā nirūpita abheda sambandha avacchinna avacchedaka tā avacchedaka tvena jijñāsitaḥ yaḥ dravya tvasya viśeṣa dharmaḥ tadvat abhinna dravya abhinnam idam iti bodhaḥ

original: idaṃ kasyetyatra svasamabhivyāhṛtapadopasthāpyatāvacchedakadharmāvacchinnod‌deśyātanirūpitasvārthānvayitāvacchedakadharmāvacchinnavidheyatānirūpitanirūpitatvasambandhāvacachinnā' vacchedakatvena jijñāsitanirūpitatvapratiyogitvanyūnavṛttidharmāvacchinne kiṃpadasya śaktiḥ|
analyzed: idam kasya iti atra sva samabhivyāhṛta pada upasthāpyatā avacchedaka dharma avacchinna uddeśya ata nirūpita svārtha anvayitā avacchedaka dharma avacchinna vidheyatā nirūpita nirūpita tva sambandha avacachinnā avacchedaka tvena jijñāsita nirūpita tva pratiyogitva nyūna vṛtti dharma avacchinne kim padasya śaktiḥ

original: idantvāvacchinnanirūpitasvatvatvāvacchinnavidheyatā'vacchedakatāvacchedakatvena jijñāsitanirūpatitvapratiyogitvanyūnavatidharmāvacchinnavatsvat‌vavadidamiti bodhaḥ| uttaravākyaṃ tatra svīyamiti prayogaḥ|| bhavataḥ putrāḥ kati, ityatra vidheyatāvacchedakasaṃkhyāyāṃ kiṃpadārthasyā' bhedenā'nvayaḥ|
analyzed: idantva avacchinna nirūpita svatva tva avacchinna vidheya tā avacchedaka tvena jijñāsita nirūpati tva pratiyogitva nyūnavati dharma avacchinna vat svatva vat idam iti bodhaḥ uttara vākyam tatra svīyam iti prayogaḥ bhavataḥ putrāḥ kati iti atra vidheya tā avacchedaka saṃkhyāyām kiṃpadārthasya a bhedena anvayaḥ

original: bhavān kasya putra ityatra vidheyatāvacchedakaṣaṣṭhyarthe janyatve kiṃpadārthasyā''bhedenā'nvayaḥ| prathame jijñāsitasvārthā'bhedā'nvayitā'vacchedakatvopalakṣitadharmanyūnavṛttidharmāvacchinnā kiṃpadasya śaktiḥ| dvitīye jijñāsitasvārthā'bhedā'nvayitā'vacchedakatvopalakṣitadharmanyūnavṛttidharmāvacchinnā śaktiḥ|
analyzed: bhavān kasya putraḥ iti atra vidheya tā avacchedaka ṣaṣṭhī arthe janya tve kiṃpada arthasya abhedena anvayaḥ prathame jijñāsita sva artha abheda anvayitā avacchedaka tva upalakṣita dharma nyūna vṛtti dharma avacchinnā kiṃpadasya śaktiḥ dvitīye jijñāsita sva artha abheda anvayitā avacchedaka tva upalakṣita dharma nyūna vṛtti dharma avacchinnā śaktiḥ

original: kiminduḥ kiṃ padmamityatra avyayakimo vitarkora'theḥ prayoktuḥ saṃbhāvanātmakaṃ jñānam abhedena candrādiprakārikā saṃbhāvanā, jñānasya viśeṣyatā sambandhena prathamāntapadopasthāpye viśeṣye, prakāritā sambandhena ca tatra candrānvayaḥ|
analyzed: kim induḥ kim padmam iti atra prayoktuḥ saṃbhāvanā ātmakam jñānam abhedena candra ādi prakārikā saṃbhāvanā jñānasya viśeṣya tā sambandhena prathama anta pada upasthāpye viśeṣye prakāri tā sambandhena ca tatra candra anvayaḥ

original: saṃbhāvanāḥ saṃśayaḥ, idamadhyāhāryam, tathā ca ubhedasaṃsargāvacchinnaprakāratāsaṃsargakenduviśeṣyakasaṃśayasya viśeṣyatāsambandhenedanttvāvacchinnaviśeṣyatāko bodhaḥ| ālaṃkāritamate'tra vyañjanātaḥ śābdabodhaḥ| naiyāyikamate mānaso bodhaḥ|
